items.title: AFCS: Full Episode (Parts 1–5)
items.description: All five AFCS parts as one continuous listen, plus the cold recap. The same parts are also below individually.

items.title: AFCS: The Control Stack
items.description: How the control system is layered — the basic functions, the upper modes on top, and what the PFD shows you.

items.title: AFCS: Collective Safety & Envelopes
items.description: Power Limiting, Autorotation Protection, Low Height and Pitch Assist, plus every mode's range and minimum use height.

items.title: AFCS: Coupled Approaches
items.description: Four-degree Category I ILS, coupled ILS and GSPD speed limits, and the VOR approach switching rule.

items.title: AFCS: Failure Logic
items.description: The common response pattern behind almost every AFCS malfunction, and how each failure builds on it.

items.title: AFCS: Automatic Search Modes
items.description: The Search Mode package for SAR and offshore work, their minimum use heights, and the wave-height adjustment.

items.title: AFCS: Cold Recap
items.description: Every number from the series in one pass, no explanation — for the night before a check.

items.title: Limitations: Flown as a Sortie
items.description: Every limitation taken where you actually meet it in the flight, ramp to shutdown. Ends with a cold recap.

items.title: Electrical: Built Up, Then Taken Apart
items.description: The system woken up layer by layer, then every layer taken away — single, double and triple generator failure.

items.title: Fire Protection: Bay by Bay
items.description: How fire is detected, what the bottles can reach, and all ten drills in their ground and flight pairs.

items.title: Ice Protection: Systems and Limits
items.description: Three aircraft in one type — basic, LIPS and full IPS — what each may do, and what normal operation feels like.

items.title: Ice Protection: The Failures
items.description: Every icing malfunction organised by what you have lost: the picture, the windshields, the intakes, the rotors.

items.title: CAS: How the Aircraft Talks to You
items.description: The four caption levels, the voice warning priority list, and what to do when the alerting system goes quiet.

items.title: Engine: The Machine and Its Failures
items.description: The CT7-2E1 itself, then engine out, drive shaft failure, governor loss, autorotation and the quick ones.

items.title: Rotor & Transmission
items.description: Three gearbox numbers, the sprag freewheel, and the two oil clocks that decide the rest of the flight.
